correctness.rationale: The conic compactification T=P_{P3}(Sym²U) is 8-dimensional; the degree-4 part of (ell,Q)² has rank 10+4+1−1=14, yielding P_T(E) of dimension 21. Outside the conic the linear system is base-point free; Bertini gives generic smoothness away and irreducibility, so the unique positive-dimensional singular component is the conic and the incidence map is generically degree one. The K-theory resolution gives s(E)=(1−2h−k)/[(1−2h)^10(1−h−k)^4(1−2k)]. Independently reconstructed top relevant coefficients 579040,139412,22992,1981; base pushforward gives 579040−4·139412+6·22992−4·1981=151420. Source verifier also derives the same number by 24-point torus localization; geometry relies on Bertini and rank argument, not its numerical output.
